fact: Aron et al. state that as of January 2023, 1,266 health facilities, government and private, were reporting in the DHIS2-based HMIS, that Neno district's two hospitals and 13 health centres all report monthly through it with some report sets held only by central hospitals, and that in practice paper forms are collected from facilities and keyed into DHIS2 at the district HMIS office, Neno having begun decentralising DHIS2 entry to health centres in November 2022.
title: Towards improving district health information system data consistency, report completeness and timeliness in Neno district, Malawi
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
